items.summary: In MarketIntelPage.tsx, implement the passcode lock using the exact passcode 'BO2420075112009BP'. On the locked screen, show a styled passcode input form with a visible 'Unlock' button. After the correct passcode is entered, persist the unlocked state in sessionStorage so it survives page reloads within the session. On incorrect passcode, show a clear error message.

After unlocking the Market Intel page, display a fully functional trading signals dashboard. Include: (1) a time frame selector (1H, 4H, 1D, 1W), (2) an asset selector for at least BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, and XRP, (3) live BUY/SELL/HOLD signals with confidence scores computed from RSI, MACD, and MA crossover indicators fetched via the public CoinGecko OHLC API, (4) a live price ticker for the selected asset, and (5) indicator cards showing RSI value, MACD histogram, and trend direction. Use the existing useMarketIntelLive hook as the data source and extend it to support asset and timeframe parameters.

In the backend (main.mo), ensure getPresaleTimerEnd and getAirdropTimerEnd return the correct hardcoded end timestamps: Presale = Q1 2027 (March 31, 2027 23:59:59 UTC in nanoseconds), Airdrop = Q1 2029 (March 31, 2029 23:59:59 UTC in nanoseconds). Also expose a setTimerEnd admin method to allow future changes. Ensure these values survive upgrades.

In AcquisitionPage.tsx, fully implement the Pre-Sale tab: (1) Show a live countdown timer (days/hours/minutes/seconds) using useCountdownTimer fetching from the backend presale timer end; (2) While countdown is running, display a visually complete locked state with the timer prominently centered and explanatory text; (3) When the timer expires (unlocked flag true), reveal the full Pre-Sale registration form collecting: full name, email, phone number, wallet address, amount to invest, country; (4) On form submit, build a pre-filled WhatsApp message with all field values and redirect to WhatsApp using the existing helper in frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts using REDIRECT_CONFIG's WhatsApp number. Persist partially filled form data in sessionStorage.

In AcquisitionPage.tsx, fully implement the Airdrop tab: (1) Show a live countdown timer (days/hours/minutes/seconds) using useCountdownTimer fetching from the backend airdrop timer end; (2) While countdown is running, show a visually complete locked state with the timer and explanatory text; (3) When timer expires, reveal the Airdrop registration form collecting: full name, email, wallet address, country, referral code (optional); (4) On form submit, build a pre-filled WhatsApp message and redirect to WhatsApp using REDIRECT_CONFIG. Persist partially filled data in sessionStorage.

Complete all currently empty or placeholder frontend files with full implementations: FormsSection.tsx (render both Pre-Sale and Airdrop form sections with timers), HeroSection.tsx (animated hero with RBS logo, tagline, CTA buttons to Acquisition and Whitepaper pages), OracleSection.tsx (live oracle-style data feed cards using CoinGecko global market data from useRealWorldAnalytics), WhitepaperSection.tsx (section teaser with chapter highlights and a link to WhitepaperPage). DeveloperBlogPage.tsx and DeveloperToolsPage.tsx should render informational content with at least 3 cards each describing development resources, tools, or blog posts related to RBS/DeFi.

Audit and fix all known broken or incomplete functionality across every page: (1) Fix useCountdownTimer so it correctly handles both presale and airdrop timer types and displays 00:00:00:00 when expired rather than erroring; (2) Ensure LivePricePage authentication guard shows a clear, styled login prompt instead of a blank screen when unauthenticated; (3) Ensure AlertsCenterPage shows a styled login prompt when unauthenticated; (4) Ensure AdvancedAnalyticsPage handles empty search gracefully and shows example symbol hints; (5) Ensure AISentimentPage shows a proper loading skeleton and error retry button; (6) Ensure CommunityVotingPage poll join, vote, and create flows work end-to-end with clear user feedback toasts or inline messages.

Apply a consistent, complete visual design system across all pages. Enforce the existing gold/dark theme from index.css and tailwind.config.js everywhere: (1) All cards use the glass-card style with gold border accents; (2) All primary buttons use the gold gradient; (3) All countdown timers are displayed in large, bold segmented digit blocks with gold borders; (4) All locked-state screens show a prominent lock icon, title, and subtitle; (5) All loading states use animated gold-toned skeletons; (6) Typography is consistent using the Inter/Poppins scale defined in index.css. Fix any pages or components deviating from this theme.

Integrate real public API data for all sections that currently show placeholder or static data: (1) InsightsPage: ensure global market cap, BTC dominance, ETH dominance, 24h volume, and active cryptocurrencies count are fetched live from CoinGecko public API (/global endpoint) via useRealWorldAnalytics; (2) MarketPulsePage: ensure BTC RSI, MACD, price, and 24h change are computed from live CoinGecko OHLC and price data via useMarketPulse; (3) AISentimentPage: ensure news articles are fetched from CryptoPanic public API via useCryptoNews with sentiment derived from vote counts; (4) All public API calls must use the public (no-auth-required) endpoints and handle rate limiting with graceful error states.
